description: Header file defining the SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier class, which manages notifications for system DNS configuration changes, including observer management and configuration refresh mechanisms.

classes.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages subscription to system DNS configuration changes and notifies registered observers.

classes.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier::Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified when the system DNS configuration changes.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to receive DNS config change notifications.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from receiving DNS config change notifications.

methods.name: RefreshConfig
methods.description: Triggers a re-read of the current DNS configuration and notifies observers.

methods.name: SetDnsConfigServiceForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom DnsConfigService for testing purposes and optionally runs a refresh callback.
